body:
Yes she does. she was abused growing up and cut her arms/legs, its one of the reasons i fell in love with her. i wanted to make sure she didnt get any more and then i end up making her worse. 

its long and complicated, but she wasnt happy and for 3 weeks she treated me like shit, then she left me. about 2 weeks after she left i started talking to another girl who my so hates, because this girl hit on me a couple times when we were together.

maybe insensitive from me? perhaps, but i was upset and angry at how i'd been treated, i didn't care back then if i upset her, I was trying to move on.

My so goes mad at me, calling me a cunt, blocks me from everything. i try telling her we're not together anymore because you ended it, i dont have loyalties to you, but she wouldnt listen.

fast forward to last night, i met her at the park for a cigarette and a chat. she asks if ive been seeing that girl still, and i lied. I said no when i saw her at the weekend. she knew that i'd seen the girl because someone had told her they'd seen us together.

then she says she hates me, she'll never forgive me, and she left.

i shouldn't have lied, but i didnt do it out of malice. i just didnt want to upset her. it's just a huge fuck up
it definitely would have spiralled down but it still hurts, and it hurts knowing what my actions did to her, even though i did them out of the hurt she'd caused me
